thread:
emma: Quick async check — status on the Optimize toolkit delivery? I want a short list: current milestone, owners, blockers.

fiona: Owners: eng-platform (me) for rollout, eng-ml (dinesh) for quant recs, eng-runtime (ben) for kernel/ops. Milestone: feature-freeze for v0.9 by EOD Friday (2026-04-02).

dinesh: Quant recs are mostly done. Sent PR with model profiles and suggested per-model quant schemes. Running CI on INT for the 4x8-bit path — seeing a perf win on batch-heavy traces but 2 test flakies.

ben: Heads up — runtime needs a small kernel shim to switch to reduced-precision matmul for the 4-bit path. I have a branch (runtime/quant-shim) but it's behind a dependency on the allocator change from infra.

carla: allocator change = infra rolling patch? That patch will require a canary on dedicate-pool-2. Can SRE schedule a canary window?

emma: @carla can you propose a 2-hour canary window tomorrow 10–12 PT and add to the incident calendar? We need to avoid peak traffic.

carla: will do. tagging deploy-bot to create a canary job.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-1972123456-1, target=dedicated-pool-2, window=2026-04-01T17:00:00Z..2026-04-01T19:00:00Z :rocket:

alice: Link to the PR? Can we get a short README snippet for the devex docs — one paragraph + config example. I can draft if someone posts config.

dinesh: PR: https://git.redwood.com/r/inference/optimize-toolkit/pulls/482 — quant profiles in profiles/*.json. Failing tests are in eval/regression_tests/run_eval.sh: flaky on long-context perf assertion. Log: ```ERROR: latency regression: expected <= 0.12s/token got 0.18s/token on seq=1024 batch=8```. I think it's KV cache priming in INT.

ben: Runtime note: we see tail latency during KV priming on first few requests when cache miss rate is high. Suggest adding a warmup policy in orchestration that primes KV for the canary workload (small synthetic prefix) before traffic shift. Example config: ```yaml
warmup:
  enabled: true
  sample_prefix: "The quick brown fox"
  requests: 5
  concurrency: 2
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  timeout_ms: 15
cache:
  prefix_kv_ttl: 3600
  proactive_prime: true
```

fiona: Ownership clarifications: fiona (rollout lead) -> merge gate, ben -> runtime merge, dinesh -> quant signoff, carla -> canary schedule + monitoring runbook, alice -> devex docs. Deadlines: merge by Wed EOD, canary Thu, full roll Fri.

emma: Blockers: allocator infra change (carla), failing regression test (dinesh), runtime shim merge (ben). Any blockers that will prevent merge Wed?

dinesh: I can stabilize the test with a small tolerance bump + tagged unit that retries KV priming. Will open a tiny PR today.

ben: Runtime shim needs allocator change merged first — keeping it small. If infra can ship the allocator change by tomorrow morning, we can merge runtime by Wed.

carla: infra patch is in review (infra/allocator/PR-119). I'll push for expedited review and plan the canary window as above.

alice: I'll draft devex snippet and a one-paragraph blurb for the console release notes. ETA: EOD today.

fiona: OK team — next actions: dinesh PR for test fix (today), carla follow infra review (today AM), ben keep runtime branch ready, alice docs draft (today), I'll run merge checklist Wed morning and coordinate canary. Ping me with :eyes: when individual task is done.

emma: Thanks — tagging owners in participants list. If anything slips, call immediate sync. Otherwise we'll keep this thread as the async source of truth. :white_check_mark:

ben: :eyes: pushed runtime/quant-shim -> ready for CI.

dinesh: :eyes: opened PR 483 to add retry for KV priming.

carla: :eyes: asked infra to prioritize PR-119, added canary to calendar.

alice: :eyes: draft in docs repo under /docs/optimize-toolkit/quickstart.md — will PR.

fiona: :shipit: noted — will run the merge checklist Wed 09:00 PT.
